scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Friday’s confirmed trimming block from becoming an avoidable hand-comfort risk during school material prep.
Emerging Need: A tentative short setup becomes a long hand-cutting task after a heavy direct-session morning, while the useful personal tool remains at home.
Decision Context: Stored therapy guidance determines the duration and workload threshold, the specific pouch worth packing, and the proportionate private preparation.
Consequence: If the home-departure window passes, the task can still proceed, but the preventive setup for the long cutting block is unavailable.

parameter.subject: Friday materials queue still tentative
parameter.body: The fluency-folder printer queue may expand later this week, but the media room slot is not confirmed yet. Current placeholder remains a short tab-prep window until the copier count is final.

parameter.title: Friday direct speech session block
parameter.description: Back-to-back direct student speech sessions before afternoon materials prep.

parameter.subject: Friday fluency-folder prep confirmed
parameter.body: The copier count is final: the Friday media-room prep is now 3:15-5:30 p.m. for laminated fluency-folder tabs and classroom sets. The paper cutter is out for repair, so the finished sheets will need hand trimming after materials arrive at 1:50 p.m.; there is no off-campus errand gap before prep starts.
